implemented: Content-addressed premarket-frozen policy covers quote freshness/spread, displayed size, ADV participation/freshness, costs versus expected net alpha, projected exposure, and model confidence.
The evaluator returns named fail-closed checks, reason codes, evidence identities, and a canonical verdict digest suitable for the runner risk callback.
The runner durably records explicit no-trade/rejected and missed/rejected execution outcomes as immutable PAPER_SKIP records with decision, risk, preflight, signal and source-input attribution.
Replay rejects a changed skip record and does not call execution for pre-trade risk refusals.
blockers: Frozen gate policies and evidence sources are not automatically bound to every strategy/session.
Authoritative ADV/cost feeds, exposure-book integration, calibrated confidence, and formal eligibility wiring remain unverified.
